construction: Define F(ζ)=(Q-i0)^ζ as a distribution-valued analytic family.

Citation: Dütsch–Fredenhagen–Keller–Rejzner arXiv:1311.5424 Definition 4.2 (analytic regularization of numerical distributions) and §4.1–4.2 (complex powers / dimensionally regularized two-point functions as meromorphic families). Instantiated hypotheses: Minkowski quadratic form Q with fixed i0 orientation; principal logarithm; test functions in D(R^4); Gate0 Hessian normalization.
Classical support: (x±i0)^λ is entire in λ as a tempered distribution (Gelfand–Shilov / Hörmander complex powers), specialized to Q-i0.
Const-coeff differentiation under the pairing: □φ_λ = 4λ(λ+1) φ_{λ-1}, so □F(ζ)=4ζ(ζ+1) φ_{-1+ζ}.
Holomorphy of F near ζ=0 ⇒ □F(ζ)=ζ·G(ζ) with G holomorphic in D'.
Therefore φ_{-1+ζ}=□F(ζ)/(4ζ(ζ+1))=G(ζ)/(4(ζ+1)) is holomorphic near ζ=0 (ζ+1≠0 in a neighbourhood of 0).
